syntax.headings: ## is a heading and ### a smaller one. A hash needs a space after it: #realestate stays as text.
syntax.lists: - bullets and 1. numbers. A list inside a list is flattened.
syntax.quotes: > quotes. A last line that starts with a dash becomes the credit.
syntax.links: [words](https://example.com) or [words](/page). Other addresses are removed. You can also select words and press Add a link.
syntax.pictures: ![what it shows](IMAGE-1) on a line of its own is a place for a picture. Choose the file for it below.
syntax.other: Bold, italic, code, tables and HTML become plain words.

errors.title: These must be fixed before a draft can be made

error.headingTooLong: Line {line}: the heading is {count} characters long. A heading can have at most {maximum}. Shorten it.
error.tooManyBlocks: The article makes {count} blocks. The most is 100. Split it into two articles.
error.tooBig: The article is {count} bytes once converted. The most is 100,000. Split it into two articles.
error.inputTooBig: The pasted text is too long. The most is {count} characters. Split it into two articles.

warnings.title: {count, plural, one {# change was made} other {# changes were made}}

warning.titleLater: Line {line}: a second # title became a heading, because an article has one title.
warning.headingDeep: Line {line}: a heading with {count} hashes became a small heading. Articles have two heading sizes.
warning.headingLink: Line {line}: a link inside a heading was removed and its words kept. Headings do not hold links.
warning.nestedList: Line {line}: {count, plural, one {# item inside a list was moved up} other {# items inside lists were moved up}}. Lists inside lists are not supported.
warning.formatting: Bold, italic, strike-through and code marks were removed in {count, plural, one {# place} other {# places}}. The words were kept.
warning.linkDropped: Line {line}: a link was removed and its words kept, because its address ({detail}) is not allowed. A link must start with https:// or be a page of this site starting with /.
warning.codeBlock: Line {line}: a code block became a plain paragraph. Its line breaks and spacing were lost.
warning.table: Line {line}: a table became plain paragraphs, one per row. Its columns and borders were lost.
warning.image: Line {line}: a picture inside a sentence was removed ({detail}). Put a picture on a line of its own, like ![what it shows](IMAGE-1), to keep a place for it.
warning.imageFromAddress: Line {line}: this picture pointed to {detail}. Pictures are never fetched from the internet, so it became the place IMAGE-{count}. Choose the picture file for it.
warning.imageSlotEmpty: Line {line}: IMAGE-{count} has no picture yet, so nothing shows there. Choose a file for it, or add one later in the block editor.
warning.imageSlotRepeated: Line {line}: IMAGE-{count} was already used above, so this line was removed. Give each picture its own number.
warning.html: Line {line}: HTML tags were removed and the words kept.
warning.split: Line {line}: a long piece of text was split.
warning.splitParagraph: Line {line}: a very long paragraph was split into {count} paragraphs.
warning.splitQuote: Line {line}: a very long quote was split into {count} quotes.
warning.splitItem: Line {line}: a very long list item was split into {count} items.
warning.splitList: Line {line}: a list of more than 50 items was split into {count} lists.
warning.rule: {count, plural, one {# horizontal line was} other {# horizontal lines were}} removed.
